verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI offers local conversation checkpointing to save/resume sessions (gh-8) and can run in Cloud Shell (docs-1), but there is no evidence of cloud-synced session state that lets a developer start a task on one device/terminal and pick it up seamlessly on another device or browser. missing for 10: cross-device session sync, browser-based continuation of an existing CLI session, any documented mechanism to transfer checkpoint state between machines.
